name: parallel-lifecycle
description: Direct-discovery marketplace for the parallel-lifecycle plugin. Add this repo to install the plugin by itself; it is also published in the wider DevOtts marketplace.

plugins.name: parallel-lifecycle
plugins.description: Per-worktree isolated, disposable dev environments (app port, ephemeral Chrome/CDP, per-worktree database) behind a single .env.worktree contract, for running N parallel agentic coding sessions without collisions.
